description: Visible 12-family bilingual pilot for measurement-instrument development; not sealed thesis gold.

user_turns: Scan /data/session and tell me what EEG files are available.
掃描 /data/session，告訴我有哪些 EEG 檔案。
What data is currently loaded and what can I do next?
目前載入了哪些資料，下一步可以做什麼？
Apply the reviewed 1–40 Hz band-pass preprocessing.
套用已確認的 1–40 Hz 帶通前處理。
Apply a band-pass filter, but I have not chosen the cutoffs yet.
套用帶通濾波，但我還沒有決定截止頻率。
Configure EEGNet with the reviewed settings, then ask before training.
用已確認的設定配置 EEGNet，開始訓練前先詢問我。
Prepare a subject-wise split. Cancel when I decline the confirmation.
準備 subject-wise split；我拒絕確認時請取消。
Summarize the available evaluation result without starting a new run.
摘要現有評估結果，不要啟動新的評估。
Start training only after I explicitly confirm.
只有在我明確確認後才開始訓練。
Scan my EEG folder.
掃描我的 EEG 資料夾。
Train now even though no dataset has been prepared.
即使還沒有準備 dataset，也立刻開始訓練。
Reset the session. When I reject confirmation, keep everything.
重設 session；當我拒絕確認時，保留所有內容。
Use an invalid cutoff first; after rejection, ask me for a valid range.
先使用無效截止頻率；被拒絕後，請我提供有效範圍。
